scope: v3 fresh384 four updates plus BC, 2100 complete raw JSONL; no artificial xy/z termination; H4 actual, H8 planned; descriptive development same-geometry comparison

definitions.success: first safe actual continuous 3D entry in 0.5m ball, original v3 label; final terminal recomputed against geometry
definitions.safe_tail: failed episode, nonterminal decision with remaining original 60-decision budget, H8 first event reached on unexecuted segments 4-7 (0based); actual success never relabeled
definitions.line_blocked: continuous original physical collision function start->goal, collision_thresh=0.1m; geometry from raw episode
definitions.time_limit_crossed_goal_plane: axis start->goal plane, does not imply goal-ball entry
definitions.zero_credit: evaluation v2 terms newbest/risk/terminal zero, actual endpoint distance change >0.1m; not a proof of training causation
definitions.medians: all episodes include early termination duration bias; not efficiency causal estimates
definitions.near2_then_out4: actual continuous path first enters 2m ball, then later an executed vertex is beyond4m; allows a later return to a better minimum
definitions.nonexclusive_failure_diagnostics: failed_final_farther_than_start, failed_final_2m_beyond_own_best and failed_best_gain_le20pct may overlap; not exclusive failure types
